elements.description: A table of rows and columns, drawn from the same column definitions on both sides. Named `data-table` and not `table` because `<table>` is a native html element and vue refuses to redefine one. The two renderers part on what a cell value may be, and they have to: the client one runs before the data is known, so it takes functions for `format`, `href`, `icon` and `params` and resolves routes itself; the server one runs after, so it takes the result already computed in the row — `{label, href}` for a link, `{icon, href}` for an icon. `secondary` greys the header too on the client and only the body on the server, and the refreshing overlay has no server equivalent because a page that is being redrawn is not on screen.
